I have only a small piece of land here, just 0.16 hectares, and I need to be careful with my money and resources. I will put my energy into this plot using what I already have—some manure from our animals and seed I saved from last season—because buying fertilizer and improved seed is too costly for this plot when my family also needs to eat. We will do all the work ourselves with hoes, as we always have, since paying workers is not possible for such a small plot, and we rely on the rains as we have no pump or irrigation scheme here.
